_readme: SHIP MANIFEST — the last line of defense before anything is packaged.
Adrian reviews this file before every cut. Two sections:
rules: prefix rules over maya_tools/ paths. Anything matching a
ship:false rule is EXCLUDED from the free zip (deepest matching
rule wins). Everything else ships. Every rule carries a note
saying why, so a future reader never has to guess.
known_dirs: the roll-call. Every directory (top level and one level
down) under maya_tools/ that contains files must be listed here.
package_release FAILS LOUDLY if a directory exists on disk that
this list does not acknowledge — a new tool cannot slip into the
zip without being ruled here first.
This manifest governs DIRECTORIES. File-level excludes
(_EXCLUDE_MAYA_TOOLS_FILES), _dev/ folders at any depth, and the
paid-pack boundary (paid_manifest.json) are enforced separately by
